title: Add random unjudged pictures as background negatives
body: Verdicts from reviews are not a random sample: rejects are near-misses that some source already thought looked like the tag. A classifier fitted only on them learns the fine line between near-misses and positives but may never see an ordinary picture, and then score unrelated pictures highly. Add a few hundred random unjudged pictures as weak negatives (most pictures do not carry a rare tag), down-weighted, and compare with verdicts-only. Measure the share of the top 100 that a person or the held-out verdicts confirm. It counts if top-100 precision rises without held-out average precision falling.
